placeHelp: Type the beginning of its name, then pick it from the list. It must exist in « Places ».
placeNone: No place of that name in « Places ».
placeSearchFailed: The search for places did not go through. Try again in a moment.
placeSheetsFailed: The sheets already entered for this place could not be read: a duplicate sheet will be refused when saved.
dateHelp: A year is enough: the sheet holds for that year. Filling in the end makes it a span. A place cannot have two sheets for the same year.
calendarHelp: The day counted in the Julian or the Gregorian calendar.
importanceHelp: When the city appears on the map: a capital is seen from afar, a large city as you zoom in, a city close up.
unreachable: The server does not answer: the sheet is not saved. What you typed is kept; try again in a moment.
serverFault: The server answered unexpectedly: the sheet is not saved. What you typed is kept; the detail is in the browser’s console.
yearMissing: A year at least is needed.
marginRange: A margin of 1 year at least.
yearZero: There is no year 0: 1 BC is followed by AD 1.
dayWithoutCalendar: A day needs its calendar, Julian or Gregorian.
calendarWithoutDay: A calendar only matters for a day.
noSuchDay: That month has no such day that year.
marginWithoutCirca: A margin only goes with « circa »: an exact year has none.
reversed: The end comes before the start.
reasonsHelp: Why it has that importance: power, religion, trade… Optional. The list is completed in « Importance reasons ».
reasonsNone: No reason entered yet: the list is completed in « Importance reasons ».
testimoniesHelp: Optional. One line for each thing a source says of the city at that date — for example: Buringh 2021, population, 25,000.
sourceHelp: The one that says what the line says of the city. Type to search; missing from the list, “+” creates it.
subject: About
subjectHelp: What the source speaks about: the population, the importance, a reason, the polity holding the city, or a community.
whereHelp: Where the source says it: a page, a line, a column. Optional.
subjectMissing: Say what the source speaks about.
populationInvalid: The number of inhabitants, whole, from 0.
lineImportanceMissing: Choose the importance the source gives.
reasonMissing: Choose the reason the source gives.
lineImportanceHelp: The order of city the source gives it.
reasonResults: {count, plural, =0 {no reason} one {# reason} other {# reasons}}
periodNameHelp: The name the place bore at this date — Ancyra for Ankara in 1100. It is the one the map writes. Type to search among this place’s names; missing from the list, “+” creates it for this place: enter the name in each language and its source there.
periodNameCreate: Create a name of the time for this place
periodNameNoPlace: Choose the place first: the names of the time offered are this place’s.
holderTitleHelp: The one the city answered to at this date, with the title held there: “Mathias II, count of Nantes”. Type to search; missing from the list, “+” creates it. Its chain of vassalage is built below.
chainNoYear: Enter the sheet’s year: the chain is read at that year.
chainFailed: The chain could not be read. Try again in a moment.
chainReadings: The sources diverge: {count} readings, all kept.
chainRankInversion: To check: “{vassal}” ranks higher than its suzerain, “{suzerain}”.
chainLoop: the links contradict one another: this title comes back in its own chain
linkSuzerainHelp: The one {name} answered to at this date. Missing from the list, “+” creates it.
linkFailed: The link could not be saved. Change the suzerain or the source to try again.
linkClose: Close this line without saving it
holderNameMissing: Give the polity’s name: an id alone cannot be read.
qidInvalid: A Wikidata id is Q followed by digits — for instance: Q4948.
lineHolderHelp: The polity holding the city according to this source, by its name.
lineHolderMissing: Give the polity the source names.
byDistrictHelp: Ticked: the source proves the lord of the district, not this city by name — the city is inferred from it. Untick it once a source names the city itself.
lineHolderAsWrittenHelp: Optional — the name as the source writes it, copied as it stands: « Mathieu, comte nantais ».
quotationHelp: The source’s own words, copied as they are. Optional, but it is what lets the line be checked without the book.
showInAtlas: Show the city in the atlas
showInAtlasHelp: Ticked, the city appears in the published atlas. Unticked, it stays in the contribution and in the Cartographer, which uses it to place the borders.
communitiesHelp: Optional. The communities the sources attest in the city at that date — for example, in Toledo in 1100: catholic dominant, Muslim present, Jewish present. Each needs its « A community » line in « What the sources say ».
confessionHelp: The list is completed in « Confessions ».
confessionsNone: No confession entered yet: the list is completed in « Confessions ».
communityUnsourced: Add, in « What the sources say », an « A community » line citing this confession.
confessionTwice: This confession is already in the list: keep one community per confession.
lineConfessionHelp: The community the source speaks of, by its confession.
weightHelp: Dominant: the larger part of the city. Present: a quarter, a minority.
weightAttestedHelp: Ticked when a source says that weight. Unticked, the weight is a deduction: the presence is attested, the weight supposed, and the map will show it uncertain.
sovereignHelp: Ticked: it answers to no one at this date — the chain stops at it, with no ⊕ above. Saved with the sheet.
sovereignFailed: “Sovereign” could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
holderSovereignHelp: Ticked: the city is a sovereign state — its holder answers to no one at this date, with no chain of vassalage. The Cartographer will ask to make it a country. Saved with the sheet.
holderSovereignDrops: {count, plural, one {Its link of vassalage will be removed on saving — for every city of this title.} other {Its # links of vassalage will be removed on saving — for every city of this title.}}
linkSourceHelp: Optional: the one that states this link.
linkSuzerainMissing: Choose the suzerain, or close the line with ✕.
chainNotSaved: The chain of vassalage is not saved: see the red message under the « Vassal of » line.
fixFields: Nothing is saved: some fields are to correct, see the messages in red.
linkShared: This link serves every city held under this title: changing or removing it does for them too.
chainHolderNotSaved: The chain of vassalage is not saved: see the red message under the « Sovereign » box of « Held by ».
chainNotSavedNoYear: The chain of vassalage is not saved: enter the sheet’s year, the chain is read at that year.
chainNotSavedNoHolder: The chain of vassalage is not saved: first choose the person and title of « Held by ».
removalRefused: The link « {vassal}, vassal of {suzerain} » was not removed: the server refused — « {message} ». It is still in the base; the rest of the chain and the sheet are not saved.
removalFailed: The link « {vassal}, vassal of {suzerain} » was not removed: the server does not answer. It is still in the base; the rest of the chain and the sheet are not saved. Try again in a moment.
removalRefusedUnnamed: A link closed by ✕ was not removed: the server refused — « {message} ». It is still in the base; the rest of the chain and the sheet are not saved.
removalFailedUnnamed: A link closed by ✕ was not removed: the server does not answer. It is still in the base; the rest of the chain and the sheet are not saved. Try again in a moment.
